Five merged pull requests since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `CriteriaBuilder` under `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate`. Newest first, with the commit date on the default branch:

1. **PR #6598** (TRUNK-6707, Global Properties full caching), 2026-10-01. Changes `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateAdministrationDAO.java` at lines 104, 112 and 136.
2. **PR #6410** (TRUNK-6731, obs retrieval paging), 2026-08-20. Adds a Javadoc `{@link}` reference to `createOrderList(CriteriaBuilder, Root, List)` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateObsDAO.java` (around line 192). This is a comment-only match.
3. **PR #6359** (TRUNK-6681, LocationSearchCriteria pagination), 2026-07-21. Adds `CriteriaBuilder` parameters in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java` at lines 476, 494 and 502.
4. **PR #6079** (TRUNK-6633, ConceptSearchCriteria search), 2026-06-01. Adds `CriteriaBuilder` usage in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateConceptDAO.java` at lines 1164, 1209 and 1240.
5. **PR #6088** (TRUNK-6635, LocationSearchCriteria search), 2026-05-18. Adds `session.getCriteriaBuilder()` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateLocationDAO.java` at line 456.

Other commits in the window also contain `CriteriaBuilder` but do not touch the hibernate directory: #6668 (test and service files only) and #6315 (`ObsSearchCriteriaBuilder` and `MedicationDispenseCriteriaBuilder` usages outside the DAO package). I left them out.

Caveats:
- No pinned head was given, so I searched the default branch of `openmrs-core`. Falkon does not show a branch name for this repository, so I could not confirm the default branch is the main line.
- The dates are commit dates from the search. I did not check the PR merge timestamps separately.
- Matching is by substring, so `ObsSearchCriteriaBuilder` would also match. No hibernate-directory line matched only because of that.
